Biblical fragments
The two Masorahs, sometimes fuller than in the editions (see
fol. 3
to xxi. 2). At end of 23rd (MS. 22nd) Psalm are the words
עד כאן ביום ראשון
; all with vowel points and accents.

Hebrew

Psalms
The divisions are marked for the Psalms, no number for Ps. i: Ps. ii is in the MS. i. Many omissions supplied on the margins by a later hand.
